swaps.line: kinda chic to know where the yard is
swaps.why: the actual way in: dark corridor, disco-ball ceiling, bright yard beyond, far more literal than the neon and perfect for centred text over the dark walls

swaps.line: kinda chic that friday starts at five
swaps.why: golden-hour storytelling at a full picnic table is exactly five-o-clock-friday energy, warmer and sharper than the flat daytime parasol shot

swaps.line: kinda chic to know every word when the dj plays that song
swaps.why: a 50-something woman arms up singing every word beats a b/w dj-booth wide; literal, colour, and covers the older crowd the brand wants

swaps.line: kinda chic to hear the sax before you see it
swaps.why: colour sax player deep in the amber-lit crowd, sharper and warmer than the b/w version, which also currently doubles for line 15

swaps.line: kinda chic to have live sax with your second drink
swaps.why: sax player smiling among the benches with drinks in shot; removes the duplicate pairing with line 14

swaps.line: kinda chic when the dj plays it anyway
swaps.why: tattooed hand nudging the mixer is the exact moment of the request going in, closer and more tactile than the b/w booth shot

swaps.line: kinda chic to dance where there is no dancefloor
swaps.why: overhead of a woman dancing literally between the picnic benches, distinctive angle and daylight colour

swaps.line: kinda chic when you can still hear each other
swaps.why: two women actually in conversation across a table is the literal reading; the current night dance shot says the opposite

swaps.line: kinda chic to match your drink to your bag
swaps.why: delivery-grade version of the same lv-bag-and-frozen-drink setup, cleaner file and nicer light than the reposted carousel copy

swaps.line: kinda chic to watch them build it in front of you
swaps.why: pint mid-pour at the tap with the head forming is drink-being-built in real time, and it removes the duplicate with line 21

swaps.line: kinda chic to drink something frozen in leicester
swaps.why: woman in denim actually drinking the frozen one with attitude beats the product-on-bench shot, and un-duplicates lines 20/24

swaps.line: kinda chic to hold a proper glass outdoors
swaps.why: hands mid-cheers on two proper copas outdoors; the line is about holding, the current shot is a static glass

swaps.line: kinda chic to be on first name terms with the bar
swaps.why: smiling exchange across the bar as the daiquiris land; shows the relationship from the reader's side and frees up the bartender photo used three times

swaps.line: kinda chic that nobody asks what you do for a living
swaps.why: two 40s blokes creasing up under the thatch parasol, same mixed-age warmth but in colour, and un-triples the current photo (32/33/52)

swaps.line: kinda chic to bring your mum and your mates
swaps.why: an actual multi-generation table of women smiling together is the literal mum-and-mates photo; current pairing is two older men

swaps.line: kinda chic that every table is the best table
swaps.why: overhead of the whole yard with every bench full shows the claim; current shot is one woman at one table

swaps.line: kinda chic to laugh at nothing for a full minute
swaps.why: head-thrown-back laughter between three friends, sharper and in colour, and it frees the b/w photo currently carrying lines 7, 10 and 35

swaps.line: kinda chic to be the loudest table and the nicest
swaps.why: a full bench turning round to raise pints and steins is literally the loudest, friendliest table in the yard

swaps.line: kinda chic to move tables as the sun moves
swaps.why: woman mid-move between sunlit tables with arms out, thatch parasols around; literal movement plus it un-triples the current photo (29/36/41)

swaps.line: kinda chic to sit outside in leicester and mean it
swaps.why: rule fix: the current photo has a st george's cross in the bunting, which this series bans; replacement is the lush green sunny yard wide with clean pastel bunting

swaps.line: kinda chic to watch it get dark from outside
swaps.why: dusk sky with the festoon and balcony lights just coming on is the exact moment the line describes, and the current night wide already carries lines 1, 3 and 4

swaps.line: kinda chic when the staff are having more fun
swaps.why: two staff play-wrestling with a tongue out behind the bar is literally staff having more fun than anyone; current shot is a bartender at the till

swaps.line: kinda chic that they know your face
swaps.why: bartender in the trailer smiling in recognition at a customer, a real they-know-you moment, and it stops one bartender photo covering 31/44/45

swaps.line: kinda chic to dress up for a picnic bench
swaps.why: five dressed-up women actually sat at a picnic bench, literal and warm, and it splits lines 48/49 which share one photo

swaps.line: kinda chic to wear white and risk it
swaps.why: white broderie dress dancing with a drink on the go is the risk in action, sharper than the shared group shot

swaps.line: kinda chic to get ready for a courtyard
swaps.why: rule fix: current photo contains flag bunting; replacement is two glammed-up friends posing in the courtyard, which is also more literal for getting ready

swaps.line: kinda chic to be someone's favourite regular
swaps.why: older regular in his good shirt carrying two pints back from the bar, pure favourite-regular energy, in colour and razor sharp

bonus_lines.line: kinda chic to love a car park this much
